objective: Localize the baseline H-alpha residual by phase and fixed velocity band, separate missing support and reference mixing from observed residual direction.
primary: Full-data common reference and conditional GP mean with original baseline RV/amplitude; fixed-width uniform velocity-subbin means, equal exposure weights and complete-band support.
variants: Original display for traceability; distinguish partial coverage from complete fixed bands.
Common B/C/R exposure support for early phase comparisons; band-specific complete support shown separately.
Primary/complementary pixels, per-night/order and predeclared coarse phase bins.
Fixed-GP conditional covariance and global RV/amplitude local-refit sensitivity, retaining cross-phase reference covariance.
Empirical simultaneous-order time blocks of 1, 2, 4 and 8 exposures and all block offsets; do not bridge cadence gaps.
Native phase-band additive log-flux correction GLS with unsupported columns removed and reference/GP response recorded.
interpretation: Never fill missing velocity bins or extrapolate a complete late-phase blue band from its red edge.
Positive residual denotes observed log contrast exceeding baseline plus conditional GP; negative denotes a model excess on this processed-data contrast.
Display phase localization is not intrinsic atmospheric localization: common-reference and GP subtraction couple phases and bands.
Sign agreement across pixel/order/weighting controls and uncertainty-proxy intervals are descriptive; no calibrated sigma, p-value or unique physical attribution is claimed.
The same data select and assess local corrections; a reduced GLS score is a diagnostic and not evidence of a predictive physical model.
If full-band support or uncertainty is inadequate, report unresolved instead of asserting a missing physical effect.
validation: Linear maps remove arbitrary time-common native spectra and reproduce direct display calculations.
Generic covariance retains cross-phase terms and includes fitting the conditional GP mean.
Native local GLS injection recovery and normal-equation/rank checks; verify unsupported coefficients are not assigned finite estimates.
Source/input and saved-receipt hash checks; preserve the prior audit report and evidence.
